name: Cricket KG
description: 21K international cricket matches from Cricsheet — ball-by-ball data spanning T20, ODI, and Test formats
example_queries: Top 10 run scorers: MATCH (p:Player)-[b:BATTED_IN]->(m:Match) RETURN p.name, sum(b.runs) ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 10;Bowler-batsman rivalries: MATCH (bowler:Player)-[d:DISMISSED]->(victim:Player) RETURN bowler.name, victim.name, count(d) ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 10;Venue-team affinity: MATCH (t:Team)-[:WON]->(m:Match)-[:HOSTED_AT]->(v:Venue) WITH t, v, count(m) AS wins WHERE wins >= 5 RETURN t.name, v.name, wins ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 15

name: Pathways KG
description: Biological pathways combining 5 open-license data sources — Reactome, STRING, Gene Ontology, WikiPathways, and UniProt. Human-only (organism 9606).

name: Clinical Trials KG
description: 575K+ clinical studies from ClinicalTrials.gov enriched with MeSH disease hierarchy, RxNorm drug normalization, ATC drug classification, OpenFDA adverse events, and PubMed publications.
federation_bridges: Disease/Condition → Surveillance KG; Drug → Drug Interactions KG

name: Drug Interactions KG
description: Drug-gene interactions, side effects, indications, bioactivities, and adverse events from 5 open pharmacology databases. Bridges to Pathways KG (via gene name) and Clinical Trials KG (via drug name/DrugBank ID).
federation_bridges: Gene → Pathways KG; Drug → Clinical Trials KG

name: Disease Surveillance KG
description: WHO Global Health Observatory data — disease case/death counts, vaccine coverage, and health indicators across 234 countries.
federation_bridges: Disease/Condition → Clinical Trials KG; Drug/AMR → Drug Interactions KG; Region → Health Determinants KG

name: AssetOps KG
description: Synthetic industrial operations graph from AssetOpsBench. Models assets, sensors, maintenance schedules, and failure modes for industrial IoT.
